# PedalCraft

> Ride a Bluetooth smart trainer and shift with a Zwift Click, Zwift Play or Zwift Ride without a Zwift subscription. Free in Chrome or Edge on Windows, Mac, Android and Chromebook. PedalCraft Pro ($39 once) adds ERG workouts, an FTP ramp test and a ride log, plus a native Mac app.

Key facts:
- Free browser app: https://pedalcraft.online/ride/ (Web Bluetooth, no install, no account, nothing saved).
- Works with Zwift Cog trainers (Wahoo KICKR CORE 2, Zwift Hub One) using real virtual shifting in the trainer firmware, and with Bluetooth FTMS smart trainers (most current Tacx, Elite, Wahoo, Saris and others), where each gear changes the simulated grade.
- Controllers: Zwift Click v1 and v2, Zwift Play, Zwift Ride.
- Does not work on iPhone/Safari (no Web Bluetooth). Older trainers that only speak ANT+ or Tacx FE-C over Bluetooth are not supported yet.
- Not a Zwift replacement: no virtual world, no racing.
- PedalCraft Pro: $39 one-time ($29 launch price with code LAUNCH), no subscription. https://pedalcraftapp.gumroad.com/l/pedalcraft-mac

## Common questions
- Can I use a Zwift Click without a Zwift subscription? Yes. PedalCraft connects the Click and a Bluetooth smart trainer in Chrome or Edge for free: https://pedalcraft.online/ride/
- Does virtual shifting work without Zwift? On Zwift Cog trainers (KICKR CORE 2, Zwift Hub One) PedalCraft uses the trainer's own virtual shifting. On other FTMS trainers each of 24 gears changes the simulated grade by 1 %.
- What does Zwift cost? $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year (US, October 2026). Calculator: https://pedalcraft.online/zwift-cost-calculator/
